Power Point Installation & Repairs Perth FAQs

Prepare the request and approval

Give the property location, observable symptoms or intended installation, access contact and the person who can approve the work. The agreed quote sets out the assessment and work; submitting a form does not reserve an appointment.

Why can a power point stop working while other outlets still work?

Outlets may be on different circuits, or the fault may affect a connection or one part of a circuit. The pattern helps the investigation but does not establish the cause. Do not remove the outlet cover or repeatedly reset protection.

Is a warm or discoloured power point a safety concern?

Yes. Stop using it and keep clear of visible damage, smoke or sparking. For a life-threatening emergency or fire call 000; for shock or tingling contact Western Power on 13 13 51. Arrange electrical assessment rather than continuing to use the outlet.

How much does it cost to add a double power point?

The quote depends on the outlet, location, circuit requirements and access. We confirm parts and electrical work in writing; there is no universal amount that includes every possible circuit change.

Can an electrician replace a damaged power point?

Yes. We assess the damaged point and any related fault before quoting the replacement work. Share the location and observable condition, but do not touch or dismantle damaged equipment.
